newsitem.title: USA: Colorado cattle trade $1-$2 lower - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Colorado cattle trade $1-$2 lower - USDA.

text.p: Trading of slaughter cattle active Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers 1.00-2.00 lower than last week.
Carcass basis sales mostly 3.00 lower, instances 4.00 lower, than last week.
Sales reported on 8,800 steers and 9,000 heifers
Slaughter steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1250 lbs
66.00. Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1250 lbs
Slaughter heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1100 lbs
66.00. Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 106.00-108.00.
Confirmed Sales: 17,800 Last Week: 5,200 Last Year: 800
Week to Date : 17,900 Last Week: 6,000 Last year: 800
